content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u seewɑ Giliɡɑlin di u dɑ Bokimuɔ. Mɑ Gusunɔ u Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ sɑɑ ɡɔrɑdo win nɔɔ sɔɔn di u nɛɛ, nɑ bɛɛ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di nɑ kɑ bɛɛ nɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ nɑ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri. Nɑ nɛɛ, nɑǹ nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑmɔ pɑi ye nɑ kɑ bɛɛ bɔkuɑ.
Nɑ mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, i ku rɑ kɑ tem mɛn tɔmbu ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke. I ben bũu sɑ̃ɑ yenu kɔsukuo. Adɑmɑ iǹ nɛn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɛ. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kuɑ mɛ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ nɑǹ bu ɡirɑmɔ bɛɛn min di. Bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛɛn bɔkuɔ, bɑ n sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn wɛrɔbu, kpɑ ben bũnu nu ko bɛɛn yinɑ.
Sɑɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi, u ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ nɔɔɡiru suɑ bɑ swĩ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ yɑm mi sokɑ Bokimu. Miyɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ.
Yosuen ɡɔɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yosue u wɑ̃ɑ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, u derɑ Isireli bɑɑwure u dɑwɑ u win tem mwɑ mɛ mu kuɑ wiɡim.
Tɔn be, bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃wɑ Yosuen wɑɑti kpuro sɔɔ kɑ mɑɑ ɡuro ɡuro be u derin wɑɑti sɔɔ, be bɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu kpuro wɑ ni Yinni Gusunɔ u Isirelibɑ kuɑ.
Yosue, Nunin bii, Yinni Gusunɔn sɔm kowo, u kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wunɔbu kɑ wɔkuru (110) mɑ u ɡu.
Bɑ nùn sikɑ win temɔ Tinnɑti Herɛsiɔ, Efɑrɑimubɑn berɑ ɡiɑ Gɑɑsin ɡuurun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ.
Sɑɑ yen tɔmbu kpuro bɑ ɡu, mɑ be bɑ seewɑ ben ɑyenɔ bɑǹ Yinni Gusunɔn bɛɛrɛ yɛ̃. Mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ duɑri ye u rɑɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ kuɑ.
Isirelibɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn
sɑ̃ɑru deri
Ye Isirelibɑ bɑ kuɑ, yɑǹ Yinni Gusunɔ dore. Domi bɑ nùn deri bɑ dɑ bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ ni bɑ rɑ soku Bɑɑlibɑ.
Bɑ Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn yinni deri wi u bu yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di. Mɑ bɑ be bɑ bu sikerenɛn bũu ni bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑɑlibɑ kɑ Asitɑɑtebɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ bɑ nu wiru kpĩiyɑmmɛ. Yerɑ n derɑ Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru seewɑ.
Mɑ u bu tɔn diobu nɔmu bɛriɑ bɑ bu ye bɑ mɔ kpuro ɡurɑri. U mɑɑ bu ben yibɛrɛ be bɑ bu sikerenɛ dɔre. Bɑǹ mɑɑ kpĩɑ bɑ kɑ tii yinɛ.
Bɑɑmɑ mi bɑ tɑbu dɑ, Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ dewɑ bu kɔ̃sɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri. Bɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ tɑ kpɑ̃.
Yen biruwɑ u bu kpɑrobu seeyɑ be bɑ koo bu fɑɑbɑ ko tɔn diobun nɔmun di.
Kɑ mɛ, bɑ ku rɑ kpɑro ben ɡere wure. Bɑǹ kɑ Gusunɔ turo yɔ̃re. Bũnɑ bɑ rɑ sɑ̃. Mii mii bɑ swɑɑ ye deri ye ben bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ rɑɑ swĩi. Bɑǹ mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ.

Yinni Gusunɔ ù n bu kpɑro wɛ̃, u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑ yɛ̃ro u kɑ bu wɔrɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmɑn di, kpɑro win wɑɑti kpuro sɔɔ. Domi u rɑ ben wɔnwɔndu wɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ weeweenu mɔ̀, be bɑ bu tɔ̃yɑ mɔ̀ bɑ bu nɔni sɔ̃ɔmɔn sɔ̃.
Adɑmɑ kpɑro wi, ù n ɡu, bɑ rɑ mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ kowɑ n kere ben bɑɑbɑbɑ. Bũnɑ bɑ rɑ kɑsu bu wiru kpĩiyɑ bu sɑ̃. Ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ rɑ bɔbiewɑ bu kɑ swɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye swĩi kɑ deɡɑnɡɑm.
Yinni Gusunɔ
u Isirelibɑn lɑɑkɑri mɛɛrɑ
Kpɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ bu mɔru ko ɡem ɡem u nɛɛ, tɔn be, bɑ nɛn woodɑ sɑnkɑ ye nɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃. Bɑǹ mɑɑ nɛn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑǹ mɑɑ bu bweseru ɡɑru ɡirɑmmɛ bwese ni Yosue u deri sɔɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u ɡu.
Bwese niyɑ kon kɑ ben lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri, kpɑ n wɑ bɑ̀ n koo lɑsɑbu ko, bu nɛn swɑɑ swĩi, nɡe mɛ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u bwese ni deri, uǹ kɑ nin ɡirɑbu sɛnde.
